scope: Public synthetic development diagnostics only; not an independent benchmark, not OHR-Bench, not a complete RAG answer-accuracy evaluation.
limitations: Two cloud rounds used the same four development images; they are repeated diagnostics, not eight independent samples.
Round 1 zero-confirmation outcomes and round 2 Chinese-axis pending/missing-unit refusal are preserved.
Crop agreement uses one fixed OCR engine and is not independent semantic verification; correlated high-score errors are retained.
Local preprocessing diagnostics did not alter source images, business logic, recognition thresholds, or accepted production verdicts.
The padding experiment includes all seven available label-development images plus one Chinese chart axis; missing source detections remain missing.
